data.question_title: Out of 6 boys and 4 girls, a group of 7 is to be formed. In how many ways can this be done if the group is to have a majority of boys?
data.explanation_txt:
1 girl and 6 boys \(=^{4} C_{1} \times ^{6} C_{6} =4\)

2 girls and 5 boys \(=^{4} C_{2} \times ^{6} C_{5} =36\)

3 girls and 4 boys \(=^{4} C_{3} \times ^{6} C_{4} =60\)

Hence total ways \(60+36+4=100\).
